body:
UI strings are English-only across both clients (e.g. the "en" locale I hardcoded
in web `lib/relativeTime.ts`; all labels/buttons literal English). Currency is
handled, but there's no general localization layer.

Low priority / capture-only per the user ("I don't really care"). If picked up:
extract user-facing strings and add a locale layer on each client (web: an i18n
lib or a lightweight message catalog; android: standard string resources), pick up
the device/browser locale, and localize date/relative-time formatting (relativeTime
web + android's LastSeen). No server involvement beyond anything already localized.

Not started.
title: i18n: UI strings are English-only; no localization layer
